production_decision: Integrate direct signed SMUL8 only; retain existing wider SMUL16/24/32 correction-based kernels.

signed_bound_s8xu8.property: C=1 iff mathematical product is non-negative

signed_index_u8xs8.property: C=1 iff mathematical product is non-negative

smul16_hybrid.description: signed-aware X-high-byte row plus one remaining sign correction

signed_32x8_row.relevance: Exact signed top-row subproblem for 16x32, and signed final-row subproblem for 32x32.

conclusion: Direct signed partial-product formation is a decisive win at 8x8. In the tested wider quarter-square compositions, sign-extension/carry composition costs erase that advantage: the 16x16 hybrid is dominated, and the exact 32x8 signed-row building block needed by 16x32 and 32x32 is slower and would require an additional table family. This does not prove global optimality of correction-based wide multiplication, but no wider production replacement was found in this pass.
